convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom for a custom indicator (StochasticCGOscillator) and depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trading operations (position open/close, money management, new bar detection, history loading). Custom indicator logic is opaque without its source.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before calculation
TimeShiftSec - chart period in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime calculation for position open timestamps

other_exits: Long positions closed when StochasticCGOscillator Main crosses below Signal (SellPosClose gate)
Short positions closed when StochasticCGOscillator Main crosses above Signal (BuyPosClose gate)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode=LOT means fixed lot size; MMMode=FREEMARGIN/BALANCE/LOSSFREEMARGIN/LOSSBALANCE means deposit fraction/risk-based sizing using MM=0.1 as the share parameter. Exact sizing logic is in TradeAlgorithms.mqh.

custom_logic_notes: Entry uses previous bar (SignalBar=1 by default) values of buffers 0 and 1 from StochasticCGOscillator. Crossover is detected by comparing bar[1] (Ind[1] vs Sign[1]) for trend direction and bar[0] (Ind[0] vs Sign[0]) for the actual cross event. When SignalBar=0, signals are recalculated on every tick. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/SellPosClose/BuyPosClose are boolean gates that can independently disable long entries, short entries, short closes, or long closes. The Recount flag forces recalculation if CopyBuffer fails. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to position open functions for trade timing. Position close functions are called before open functions each tick.
python_conversion_notes: The StochasticCGOscillator custom indicator must be reimplemented in Python since it is not a standard built-in MT5 indicator - its internal formula is unknown from this EA alone. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library must also be reimplemented: it provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, CIsNewBar, LoadHistory, and GlobalVariableDel_ functions. The crossover detection logic (comparing Ind[1] vs Sign[1] for direction, then Ind[0] vs Sign[0] for the actual cross) must be replicated exactly. SL/TP are in points (not pips), so for a 5-digit broker on EURUSD, StopLoss_=1000 points = 100 pips and TakeProfit_=2000 points = 200 pips. The conditional MMMode logic needs careful handling: LOT mode is straightforward fixed lots, but the other 4 modes require reimplementing margin-based lot calculation from the .mqh file.
